changelog: Audit fixes: update downloads now verify SHA-256 and only accept GitHub download hosts, with a 10 MB cap; DecorView snow/leaf piles are pre-built once per size instead of rebuilt every frame; config imports are capped (10 profiles, 50 dock/hidden items each, 40-char names, no duplicates); phone token is required in the X-Token header for state-changing endpoints (Siri key/text GETs still accept the query token); shared configs no longer export weather lat/lon; Settings set-as-home now shows the result as a Toast and refreshes the list.
